Class SavingGoalsManager

java.lang.Object
com.duck.model.records.SavingGoalsManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
PropertyChangeListener, EventListener
public class SavingGoalsManager extends Object implements PropertyChangeListener
Manages saving goals CRUD operations. Validates, creates, queries, and persists saving goals. Listens for transaction and account token change events to update goal progress and fire completion alerts.
